appearance_facts.fact: A pale yellow wedge is the largest visual slice, spanning roughly from the 12 o'clock position to the 8 o'clock position.
A red wedge is the second-largest visual slice, spanning roughly from the 8 o'clock position to the 6 o'clock position.
An orange-red wedge is the third-largest visual slice, spanning roughly from the 6 o'clock position to the 4 o'clock position.
An orange wedge is the smallest visual slice, spanning roughly from the 4 o'clock position to the 12 o'clock position.

public_definitions: Review the global energy mix dashboard, identify the largest global energy consumption source category, then route that source record to priority source monitoring for this reporting cycle.
Routing criterion: Largest global energy consumption category
Options: Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring; Route Hydroelectric to priority source monitoring; Keep Renewables on routine source monitoring
